g.text: One synthetic policy pair on :8083, from scenario to honest abstention, then a reviewer challenge
the one place a run is kept
drop the challenged baseline citation, then re-run the pair:
a one-sided change is INCONCLUSIVE with reasons, never a flip
reset clears it, nothing reaches disk
The one sentence to take away
The challenge lane re-uses the pair from step 1 and lowers a relation to INCONCLUSIVE, never to a contradiction.
The graph summary and impact plan the challenge now returns are computed beside this lane and never feed it.
Nothing is persisted, so nothing can drift out of sync with the source text.
Read from policy_evidence_demo.py, policy_proposal_contract.py, policy_mock_provider_runner.py, policy_compare.py on 2026-10-30.
